description: A three-winding transformer modeled as an equivalent star: each TransformerCircuit connects a terminal bus to the star bus, carrying that winding's series data. r_12/x_12, r_23/x_23, r_31/x_31 are optional, set together or all absent.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Unique among components of the same type; components of different types may share a name.

primary_circuit.description: The primary `TransformerCircuit` connecting the primary bus to the star bus.

secondary_circuit.description: The secondary `TransformerCircuit` connecting the secondary bus to the star bus.

tertiary_circuit.description: The tertiary `TransformerCircuit` connecting the tertiary bus to the star bus.

star_bus.description: Star (hidden) Bus that this component (equivalent model) is connected to.

parameter_units.description: Unit basis for the pairwise measured impedance fields (r_12, x_12, r_23, x_23, r_31, x_31). One basis governs all three winding pairs.

r_12.description: Measured resistance, referenced to the primary winding's base voltage, from primary to secondary windings (R1-2 in PSS/E). Units: per parameter_units — NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

x_12.description: Measured reactance, referenced to the primary winding's base voltage, from primary to secondary windings (X1-2 in PSS/E). Units: per parameter_units — NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

r_23.description: Measured resistance, referenced to the secondary winding's base voltage, from secondary to tertiary windings (R2-3 in PSS/E). Units: per parameter_units — NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

x_23.description: Measured reactance, referenced to the secondary winding's base voltage, from secondary to tertiary windings (X2-3 in PSS/E). Units: per parameter_units — NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

r_31.description: Measured resistance, referenced to the tertiary winding's base voltage, from tertiary to primary windings (R3-1 in PSS/E). Units: per parameter_units — NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

x_31.description: Measured reactance, referenced to the tertiary winding's base voltage, from tertiary to primary windings (X3-1 in PSS/E). Units: per parameter_units — NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

base_power_12.description: Base power for per unitization for primary-secondary windings. Units: MVA.

base_power_23.description: Base power for per unitization for secondary-tertiary windings. Units: MVA.

base_power_31.description: Base power for per unitization for tertiary-primary windings. Units: MVA.

admittance_units.description: Unit basis for the magnetizing_shunt admittance.

magnetizing_shunt.description: Magnetizing shunt admittance referenced to the primary circuit's base voltage. Units: per admittance_units — NATURAL_UNITS: S, COMPONENT_MVAR: MVAr, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

shunt_location.description: Placement of `magnetizing_shunt` in the equivalent star model.

title: ThreeWindingTransformer
